flags: Removed the current “nearly fifteen miles” hedge; the cache supports 14.767 miles in the official inventory and 14.8 in the byway guide, but neither uses that hedge. All other current core claims are supported.

No Wikipedia cache supplies Hermitage coordinates. Its moment has no at; placement after Goshen is based on its Goshen address and the byway guide, not a verified strip-mile position. The historic house and smokehouse qualify this business property as a landmark moment.
